crossRefs.note: That same night, Yahweh said to him, “Arise, go down into the camp, for I have delivered it into your hand.

people.name: Jonathan
people.line: Eldest son of King Saul and friend of David

translations.web: Then Jonathan said, “Behold, we will pass over to the men, and we will reveal ourselves to them.
translations.bsb: “Very well,” said Jonathan, “we will cross over toward these men and show ourselves to them.
translations.kjv: Then said Jonathan, Behold, we will pass over unto these men, and we will discover ourselves unto them.
translations.asv: Then said Jonathan, Behold, we will pass over unto the men, and we will disclose ourselves unto them.
